criteria.text: #/planner renders the real Planner page-shell contract with exactly one Planner h1 and the fixed current week of August 10-16, 2026;
criteria.test_id: issue-2002-c1: planner route renders the real shell and fixed current week

criteria.text: Previous week, Next week, and Today update the visible ISO-week date range, deterministic week fixture, hash query, and GET /weekly-plan receipt;
criteria.test_id: issue-2002-c2: previous next and Today change the deterministic week and load receipt

criteria.text: Scheduled tasks, project steps, and calendar context render in the correct day while normal and project-step backlog records remain visibly distinct from scheduled work;
criteria.test_id: issue-2002-c3: tasks project steps calendar context and backlog occupy their source-of-truth lanes

criteria.text: Scheduling normal backlog work moves it to the target day and emits the exact PATCH /tasks/:id payload receipt;
criteria.test_id: issue-2002-c4: scheduling normal work moves it and emits the correct task-family receipt

criteria.text: Scheduling and completing a project step update its visible plan state and emit PATCH /project-instances/steps/:id receipts rather than task receipts;
criteria.test_id: issue-2002-c5: scheduling and completing a project step use project-step receipts

criteria.text: Creating scheduled and unscheduled tasks through the create inspector updates the correct plan lane and summaries with a POST /tasks receipt and 201 status;
criteria.test_id: issue-2002-c6: creating scheduled and unscheduled tasks updates plan counts with POST receipts

criteria.text: Editing the Planner-supported notes and date fields persists through PATCH /tasks/:id and remains visible after the plan reloads;
criteria.test_id: issue-2002-c7: editing supported task details persists notes and date through the normal task patch

criteria.text: Single and bulk task completion update Open/All visibility, selection state, completion affirmation, and visible open/done summaries;
criteria.test_id: issue-2002-c8: single and bulk completion update visible plan summaries and affirmation

criteria.text: Every enabled client-side Planner control has an observable outcome, while filters, selection, Clear, and dialog open/close never fabricate endpoint receipts;
criteria.test_id: issue-2002-c9: client-side filters selection and dialogs have observable outcomes without fake APIs

criteria.text: The ready, loading, empty, server-error, forbidden, unavailable, and readonly state matrix is deterministic; Retry recovers without reload, empty retains an escape hatch, and readonly disables mutation while preserving inspection;
criteria.test_id: issue-2002-c10: deterministic state matrix remains actionable and Retry recovers without reload

criteria.text: Partial optional data, long RTL/CJK/emoji titles, and read-only calendar records remain usable without exposing calendar mutation controls;
criteria.test_id: issue-2002-c11: partial records long titles and read-only calendar items remain usable

criteria.text: The visible page-trace ledger records exact GET /weekly-plan, PATCH /weekly-plan/tasks/:id, PATCH /tasks/:id, PATCH /project-instances/steps/:id, and POST /tasks receipts with meaningful payload keys and simulated statuses;
criteria.test_id: issue-2002-c12: trace ledger records exact endpoint families and excludes client-only controls

criteria.text: Planner has zero serious or critical axe violations, labelled controls and ordered headings, and modal keyboard focus that traps, closes on Escape, and restores to its trigger;
criteria.test_id: issue-2002-c13: Planner has no serious axe violations and modal keyboard focus is contained and restored

criteria.text: Planner has no page-level horizontal overflow at 1440, 1024, 768, or 390 CSS pixels and remains usable with 200 percent text, RTL, reduced motion, and 44 pixel touch targets;
criteria.test_id: issue-2002-c14: Planner fits target widths text scaling RTL and 44px touch targets

criteria.text: Planner is fixture-only and loopback-isolated, uses no real API or persistent browser storage, and reloads to the identical fixed-week seed after local mutations;
criteria.test_id: issue-2002-c15: Planner fixtures are loopback-only and reload to the identical seeded week
